- Setup guide (SKILL.md) updated throughout to document the new pattern and clarify persistent session configuration.
- No runtime or API changes—this update improves default setup, webhook routing, and documentation for easier onboarding.

Version 1.0.4 of rent-a-person-ai makes setup for persistent OpenClaw integration clearer and emphasizes correct API key handling for reliability.

- Expanded documentation on "Persistent Webhook Session Setup" for always-on handling.
- Clarified environment variable requirements for API keys and agent context in OpenClaw config.
- Added guidance on avoiding fallback to WhatsApp by ensuring correct headers.
- Highlighted recommended best practices for webhook session and skill attachment.
- Improved troubleshooting steps for webhook/API failures.

- Rewrote onboarding instructions for more reliable setup and troubleshooting.

- Added troubleshooting tips for applicant message visibility issues.

RentAPerson.ai skill initial release

- Launches OpenClaw agent integration for hiring humans to perform real-world tasks.
- Provides REST API for agent registration, human discovery, bounties, bookings, messages, reviews, and calendar events.
- Supports webhook-based event notifications, including setup via tunnel with ngrok for instant delivery.
- Includes MCP tool compatibility for all major actions (search, bookings, chat, reviews, and more).
- Comprehensive documentation for API endpoints and authentication instructions.
